applies_why: The judge labels the issue UNDERDETERMINED because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, making absence of explicit verse resolution a ground for the verdict.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: Phrase: single verse does not state a link or its contrary. I weighed (1) this bars using absence of explicit verse resolution as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED; (2) it does not bar noting two actual senses that both stand, so the text's phrase without explicit textual resolution must be read against these.
why: The text's stated reason for UNDERDETERMINED is without explicit textual resolution of paternity, which uses absence of explicit textual resolution as the ground K-S2 forbids.
